Update README.md to reflect Phase 1 of the Weather Digital Twin project

- Revise project title and structure to emphasize the first phase focusing on data processing and analysis.
- Expand on project objectives, including real-time data pipeline, spatial interpolation framework, and Python-Unity communication.
- Enhance clarity on technical challenges, solutions, and core achievements, including performance metrics and validation frameworks.
- Introduce sections on technical innovations and real-world applications to highlight the project's impact and future potential.

Refactor README.md to streamline content and remove outdated sections

Add README.md for Weather Digital Twin project and include performance metrics

- Introduce a comprehensive README.md detailing the project's objectives, technical challenges, and core achievements.
- Outline the data processing pipeline, system architecture, and real-time communication methods.

- Add images for interpolation results to enhance visual understanding of the project's outcomes.

- Generate statistical metrics for different interpolation methods (bilinear, IDW, kriging, spline, RBF)

  * Error distribution and scatter plots

- Save comprehensive metrics for rain and wind (u and v components) in CSV format
- Add performance evaluation images to interpolation_stat directory

  * Bilinear interpolation

  * Kriging
  * Spline interpolation
  * Radial Basis Function (RBF)

- Implement ground truth comparison and statistical analysis
- Create new Jupyter notebook for interpolation method evaluation
